geometry_edits.rationale: Align the public threshold to the verified access edge.
Emphasize an active ground condition at the access edge.
Make the split-wing void more usable and legible.
Calm the upper massing while preserving the dominant gesture.

graph_edits.rationale: Align the public threshold with the verified access edge in the program frame.
Strengthen the active ground condition at the access edge without changing the dominant mass.
Slightly widen the split to make the public void more usable and legible.
Calm the upper massing so the void and threshold remain the dominant relations.

rationale: The candidate reads as a compact low-rise split-wing mass with a legible central void and a clear dominant bar-like body, so it is plausible for neighborhood living. It responds to the parcel as a contained, rotated figure rather than a box-filling extrusion, and the top view confirms the void is genuinely carved rather than decorative. The verified access edge is met with an open seam/threshold condition rather than a sealed face, which supports the program contract. Weaknesses remain in section: the roof/mass relationship is fairly flat and generic, so the building feels more like a solid block with a cut than a strongly articulated lived section. Overall it is coherent across views and not visibly colliding, so it passes the hard gate.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: More sculptural and curvilinear than the candidate; do not copy the roof silhouette.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Three-part low-rise massing with a central courtyard-like void and an upper bridge/connector can support a neighborhood/community threshold.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Much larger and more distributed than the candidate; avoid turning the project into a campus.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Campus-like stepped low-rise blocks around a central shared open space suggest a legible public interior for mixed neighborhood use.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: The candidate is more compact and less transparent; do not assume retail-like glazing.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Elongated mass with a courtyard void and a folded roof line can keep the ground level active while holding a clear dominant bar.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Reference is more expansive and site-adaptive; candidate should stay compact.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Terraced and connected low-rise wings can create a readable shared court and a calmer upper section while preserving public circulation.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: The reference is more complex and interwoven; candidate should remain simpler and more coherent.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Interlocking volumes with a void at the center and elevated links can produce hierarchy without fragmenting the whole.

warnings: The section is adequate but not especially expressive for upper hierarchy or daylighting.
The central void is legible, but it could be more clearly public/inhabitable at ground level.
Access-edge response is present but modest; stronger entry articulation would better support the brief.
